Driver.requirementNote: Anyone over 18 with a valid driving licence can rent.
Driver.title: Driver details
Driver.intro: We check that the person who will drive the car meets the rental conditions. Your details are used for this check only and are not saved anywhere.
Driver.demoText: It does not connect to a real licence service; do not enter your real licence number or personal details. The conditions are examples.
Driver.demoHint: Trial number: 12345678 counts as valid; one ending in 0 is expired, one ending in 9 is not on record.
